app.title: Bottle Route
buy.bulk_centre.d: A big extra count hall: far more bottles counted per hour.
buy.centre.d: Big hauls go here instead of blocking machines. Lower fee, no daily cap.
buy.dispatcher.d: Plans routes by your rules and sends trucks by itself.
buy.driver.d: One more truck on the road at the same time.
buy.horeca.d: Cafés fill a back room with glass. Bonus per pickup.
buy.hotel.d: A big back room full of bags. Bigger bonus per pickup.
buy.intake.d: Fewer trucks waiting at the gate.
buy.line.d: Counts more bottles per hour. Fees come in faster.
buy.machine.d: Citizens near here bring their bottles.
buy.machine_l.d: Holds about four times more. Fewer long trips.
buy.shop.d: No machine: the shop collects bags. You pay it a small fee per bottle.
buy.tech.d: Fixes jams, sensors, the baler and broken trucks.
coach.1: This machine collects bottles. The bar shows how full it is. Tap the machine.
coach.10: Your first bale is ready. Sell it.
coach.11: Driving far costs fuel. Look at this number. Tap it.
coach.12: Set a rule: empty this machine when it's 80 % full.
coach.13: Buy a bigger bin for the busy corner.
coach.14: Hire a second driver. Now two trucks can drive at once.
coach.2: It's almost full. Let's empty it. Tap the van.
coach.3: Tap the machine to add it to the van's route.
coach.6: Watch the van's load bar fill up.
coach.7: Now the van drives back to the depot. Tap the depot.
coach.8: The count line counts the bottles. You earn a fee for each one. Tap the coins.
coach.9: Plastic goes to the baler. Tap the baler.
coach.done: You're ready! Keep the machines from overflowing and the trucks from driving empty.
crisis.audit.b: The count line was overloaded and counts did not match. Fine paid.
crisis.bale_crash.b: One material sells for much less. Store bales if you have room.
crisis.baler_down.b: The baler stopped. Bales are waiting.
crisis.breakdown.b: A truck stopped on the road. A technician can get it going sooner.
crisis.bulk_centre.b: The counting centre took a big haul. No machine was blocked.
crisis.bulk_returner.b: Someone brought hundreds of bottles and is blocking a machine.
crisis.fuel_spike.b: Fuel costs 50 % more for a few days. Keep routes short.
crisis.glass_break.b: A truck lost its glass load.
crisis.heat_wave.b: Everyone is drinking more. Machines fill 60 % faster for two days.
crisis.jam.b: A bottle is stuck. Send a technician, or a truck crew clears it when they empty it.
crisis.match_day.b: The stadium fills up from 16:00 to 18:00. Have a truck nearby.
crisis.season.b: Tourists everywhere: seaside machines fill three times faster.
crisis.sensor_offline.b: The app says a machine has room, but it may be full.
depot.title: Depot
depot.yard_full: Yard full — the baler has stopped
err.no_driver: No free driver — hire one or wait.
err.nothing_due: No machine needs emptying by your rules.
graphics.dropped: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth. You can change it in Settings.
hud.fuel_info: Every kilometre costs fuel. Long trips to half-empty machines eat your profit.
hud.speed_locked: Faster speeds come with the Speed Pack.
iap.bundle.d: Edition, Network Pass, Speed Pack, Dispatcher+ and every look. No forced ads.
iap.comeback.d: Cash to get the network going again.
iap.cosmetics_all.d: Every livery, machine style and depot theme.
iap.depot_tropic.d: Palm trees and bright colours at the depot. Looks only.
iap.dispatcher_plus.d: 3 more trucks the Dispatcher can drive.
iap.event_kit.d: Extra cash for a busy match day.
iap.noads.d: No more forced ads or banner. Rewards without videos (same limits).
iap.offline_plus.d: Away pay for up to 10 hours at 75 %.
iap.premium.d: No forced ads, a gold truck livery and starter cash.
iap.route_pass.d: Forever: +1 Dispatcher truck, +10 % handling fees. Includes Remove Ads.
iap.skin_retro.d: Machines in a retro style. Looks only.
iap.speed.d: 3× and 4× speed, and skip the day report.
iap.starter.d: Cash and one more van for a fast start.
intro.1.b: The town just started a bottle deposit. People bring their bottles to machines.
intro.2.b: Empty them before they overflow — but every trip costs fuel.
intro.3.b: Count, press and sell. Build the cleanest network on the coast.

research.cargo_bike.d: Buy bikes for the narrow lanes.
research.compactor_truck.d: Buy big trucks that squeeze plastic.
research.counting_centre.d: Unlocks a place for big hauls.
research.second_shift.d: The depot works one more hour.
research.sensor_redundancy.d: Sensor machines stop showing wrong numbers.
research.sensors.d: Machines can get a live fill bar.
research.shop_points.d: Sign up shops as cheap return points.
research.yard_plus.d: The bale yard can grow bigger.
reward.baler.b: Get the baler running again at once.
reward.bonus.b: A little cash to start the day.
reward.done_fuel: Fuel voucher ready for your next route
reward.empty.b: Empty this full machine right now.
reward.free.b: Included with your ad-free pack — no video.
reward.fuel.b: Your next route costs half the fuel.
reward.offline.b: Watch a short video to get it twice.

season.start: Summer season! Seaside machines fill three times faster.

settings.title: Settings
shop.cap: Daily pack limit reached. Come back tomorrow.
shop.restore_failed: Could not restore. Try again later.
shop.title: Shop
shop.unavailable: The store is not available right now
tender.name: {mat} × {n}
tender.none: No tenders right now. New ones come in the morning.
tender.terms: {price} each · {pct} of today's price · by day {day}
tender.title: Tenders
tip.audit: Too many bottles waited at the count line, so you were fined.
tip.baler_down: The baler is down. A technician can fix it.
tip.breakdown: A truck broke down. Send a technician or wait.
tip.bulk: Big haul: a machine is blocked for a while.
tip.centre: Build the counting centre so big hauls stop blocking machines.
tip.dispatcher: Build the dispatch office: it plans routes from your service rules.
tip.ferry: A truck is waiting at the pier. The route time includes the wait for the boat.
tip.fuel: Fuel is expensive today. Short routes save money.
tip.gate: The intake is full and trucks wait at the gate. Add a count line or a bigger intake.
tip.heat: Heat wave: machines fill much faster than the guess shows.
tip.horeca: Cafés fill their back room with glass bags. Sign a contract and pick them up.
tip.industrial: The Industrial Estate posts bale tenders: deliver bales by a set day for a better price. Find them in the Depot.
tip.island: The island is reached by ferry. Trucks wait at the pier for the next boat.
tip.jam: A jammed machine turns everyone away. Tap it and send a technician.
tip.market: A bale price fell. You can keep bales and sell later.
tip.match: Match day today: the stadium machines will fill up in two hours.
tip.oldtown: Old Town has narrow lanes. Big trucks can't get in — use vans or cargo bikes.
tip.report: Each day you get stars for service, efficiency and depot flow. Stars raise your Green Rating.
tip.riviera: The Riviera is quiet most of the time. In the summer season, tourists bring three times more bottles.
tip.season: Summer season! Seaside machines fill three times faster for a few days. Empty them more often.
tip.sensor_offline: A sensor is wrong. The number on the map may be too low.
tip.sensors: Sensors show the real fill. Without one, the bar is only a guess.
tip.shops: Shops can collect bottles without a machine.
tip.stadium: On match days the stadium fills fast. Park a truck nearby before 16:00.
tip.tender: New tender! Accept it in the Depot, then keep enough bales ready before its day.
tip.university: Students bring lots of cans in the evening.
tip.villages: The hill villages are far away. Large machines there need fewer trips — every kilometre costs fuel.
tip.yard: The bale yard is full, so the baler stopped. Sell bales or build a bigger yard.
toast.tender_expired: A tender ran out. Your bales stay in the yard.
truck.bike.d: Tiny load, almost no fuel. Fits narrow lanes.
truck.compactor.d: Squeezes plastic, carries a lot. Main roads only.
truck.name: {type} {n}
truck.van.d: Room for about 7 full machines. Fits narrow lanes.
truck.weight: Full by weight — glass is heavy
upgrade.compactor.d: Squeezes plastic 2.5×. Jams a bit more often.
upgrade.sensor.d: Live fill bar instead of a guess.
upgrade.title: Upgrades
